description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read what the app knows about the user's SIMULATIONS — the Simulator tab's future projection, the goal seek, the what-if and the historical trade replay — without running any of them. It never starts a simulation and never starts a job. include (default ['summary']) ⊆ summary, whatif, dcaGoal, backtest. IMPORTANT: the future projection, the DCA goal and the what-if are computed on demand in the app and stored NOWHERE on the server — the only copy of what the user ran is the live-UI line 'last simulation — …' in the current turn's context; each block says resultsStoredOnServer: false and serves the INPUTS instead, so an absent result is never read as a zero. summary = what the portfolio is worth now plus the actual return, volatility and strategy horizon a projected line has to be judged against (whole-history figures; the simulator averages over its own lookback window). whatif = the `before` side a what-if is measured from (value, cash, diversification, portfolio fundamentals) and the verb that computes the `after`. dcaGoal = the goal seek's inputs, including the saved Trades-tab budget, which is NOT a recurring contribution. backtest = the historical trade replay, which IS kept server-side for an hour from when it was STARTED (the prune clock runs from the job's creation, not from its completion): state, progress and, once complete, its summary, window, coverage gaps and warnings; backtestId picks one, the default is the newest, and the per-day series, trades, decisions and assumptions are get_workload's answer, not this one's. Amounts are in the display currency; a field ending in Pct is a percent. Describes the user's own simulations; never investment advice.
